title: Empty finite sum has the coherent integral filtration
statement: Under the hypotheses that X is locally Noetherian and i : Z → X is a closed immersion with integral source, the pushforward of the empty direct sum of an ideal sheaf has a coherent integral-ideal filtration.

source.place: Tag 01YF, final paragraph of lemma-coherent-filter; empty filtration case

proof.text: The empty coproduct has zero identity by coproduct extensionality and Fin.elim0. Pushforward preserves zero objects, so its subobject lattice is a singleton. Take the constant bottom chain of length zero. Its stage is coherent by zero coherence and isomorphism invariance; Fin.elim0 discharges all quotient conditions.

theorem coherentIntegralFiltration_ideal_sum_zero
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral Z]
    (I : Z.IdealSheafData) :
    HasCoherentIntegralFiltration
      ((pushforward i).obj (∐ fun _ : Fin 0 => I.toModules))
